hook.text: 'He spread the warm bread with socks.' Your brain fires a spike 400 milliseconds after 'socks.'

buildup.text: The N400 is a brainwave response triggered by semantically unexpected words.

discovery.text: Kutas and Hillyard discovered it in 1980—it's now a standard marker of meaning processing.

twist.text: The N400 is graded—slightly unexpected words produce smaller effects than totally bizarre ones.

climax.text: It proves the brain predicts upcoming words—and reacts when predictions fail.

punchline.text: Your brain registers surprise 400 milliseconds before you feel it.
